_description: Metadata-driven orchestration template for BMQ submission intake E2E tests. Copy this file and populate the placeholder values to create a new test workflow.

_config_notes.region: Geographic region — 'NA' for North America, 'EMEA' for Europe
_config_notes.lob: Line of business abbreviation — 'RC' for Risk & Casualty
_config_notes.goldDataPath: Root path to all golden JSON files — always './resources/testData/emails/BMQ'
_config_notes.documentId: Subfolder name under goldDataPath matching the test data folder (e.g. 'umm_monoline', 'LMMBmq')
_config_notes.configFile: Path to field-name→jsonPath mapping config — always './resources/testData/emails/BMQ/config.json'
_config_notes.prodCode: Product code for submission lookup — '8901' for BMQ
_config_notes.compareFields: Array of field names from configFile to diff between actual downloaded JSON and golden file

_step_reference._overview: Steps execute in array order. Each step maps to one action in actionMap.ts. The 'output' key stores the result in ContextManager under that key name.

available_actions.sendEmail: Sends an .eml file via SMTP. Stores subject in context. MUST be step 1.
available_actions.getSubmissionId: Polls SQL Server to find submission by email subject. MUST follow sendEmail.
available_actions.validateKafkaJson: Downloads JSON from ADLS URI (stages 1200, 1700, 2200) — compares with golden file.
available_actions.uiIntake: Drives browser actions via operation dispatch — see available operations below.

mailbox_options.NA_INGESTION_RC: Standard BMQ: UMM, LMM, LifeScience, Energy, FI submissions
mailbox_options.NA_INGESTION_LMM_CONSTRUCTION: LMM Construction and Declined CMQ submissions only

uiIntake_operations.searchSubmission: Search submission by ID in SDW
uiIntake_operations.assignReviewer: Assign submission to reviewer + open intake form (60s wait for system latency)
uiIntake_operations.loadGoldenData: Pre-load 1700.json and 2200.json golden data into context
uiIntake_operations.selectAllFields: Click 'All Fields' toggle in intake form
uiIntake_operations.validateInsuredAndProducer: Validate/fill Insured and Producer tab using golden data
uiIntake_operations.validateProcessingTab: Validate/fill Processing tab using golden data
uiIntake_operations.validatePoliciesTab: Validate/fill Policies tab using golden data
uiIntake_operations.validateUwUa: [MULTI-LINE ONLY] Assert UW and UA fields are not blank
uiIntake_operations.submitForReview: Save and submit the intake transaction

stage_timeouts.1700: 900000ms  (15 min) — standardisation JSON download + compare (1200000ms for LMM Construction)

complexity_tiers.simple: Monoline. Steps: sendEmail → getSubmissionId → stages 100/500/800/1200/1700 → UI (openSDW→searchSubmission→assignReviewer→loadGoldenData→selectAllFields→validateInsuredAndProducer→validateProcessingTab→validatePoliciesTab) → submitForReview → stage 2200
complexity_tiers.medium: Same as simple BUT includes validateUwUa + fillReviewerDetails after validatePoliciesTab (multi-line), OR non-standard mailbox, OR special business rule (e.g. state-specific derivation, declined product)
complexity_tiers.complex: Multi-line with validateUwUa + fillReviewerDetails AND non-standard mailbox or extended timeouts

steps._note: STEP 1 — Always first. File name WITHOUT .eml extension. lob path = 'BMQ/<documentId>'
STEP 2 — Always second. Polls DB for submission by email subject.
STEP 6 — Kafka JSON: stage 1200 (Intermediate). Downloads + compares 1200.json
STEP 7 — Kafka JSON: stage 1700 (Standardisation). Also pre-loads golden data for UI steps. Use 1200000ms for LMM Construction.
UI STEP 2 — Search by submission ID
UI STEP 3 — Assign reviewer + open intake (includes 60s system latency wait)
UI STEP 4 — Load 1700.json + 2200.json golden data into context (skip if validateKafkaJson stage 1700 already ran — it auto-loads golden data)
UI STEP 5 — Select All Fields toggle
UI STEP 6 — Validate Insured and Producer tab
[MULTI-LINE ONLY] UI STEP 9 — Assert UW and UA fields are derived (non-blank). Remove this step for monoline.
[MULTI-LINE ONLY] UI STEP 10 — Fill reviewer details form. Remove this step for monoline.
UI STEP 11 — Save and submit intake. Stage 2200 because this triggers completion pipeline.
STEP LAST — Kafka JSON: stage 2200 (Completion). Downloads + compares 2200.json
